title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Recovery Conditions and the LCDM Limit
author: Morten Magnusson
type: foundational white paper, theoretical derivation, recovery proof
abstract: EFC introduces a regime-dependent modification to the perturbation sector of standard cosmology, parametrised by an entropy-gradient coupling alpha_L2 and a transition function Theta(z). Three analytically independent sufficient conditions are established under which EFC reduces exactly to LCDM or GR: (i) parameter limit alpha_L2 -> 0; (ii) low-entropy regime S < S_c; (iii) density saturation rho >> rho_crit. EFC therefore contains LCDM as a limiting case in the perturbation sector.

condition_III.name: Density saturation
condition_III.observational_link: Grid-AQUAL KT2 C_vw = 2.2960; KT3 Lambda-locking beta ~ 0.18

triangulated_recovery.statement: [alpha_L2 -> 0] OR [S < S_c] OR [rho >> rho_crit] ==> mu(k,z) -> 1, Sigma(k,z) -> 1
triangulated_recovery.proof: Each condition drives EFC correction to zero through a distinct physical channel; no cross-terms

corollary.statement: EFC contains LCDM as a limiting case in the perturbation sector

core_equations.eq10_triangulated: [alpha_L2 -> 0] OR [S < S_c] OR [rho >> rho_crit] ==> mu -> 1, Sigma -> 1

level_classification.claim: Compatible with LCDM in some regimes

open_problem: No consistent mapping from EFC to background expansion H(z) has been established at the Lagrangian level. The background alpha-gate was found inconsistent with joint CMB+BAO constraints. EFC operates as a perturbation-sector modification only at the level of Parts 1-3.
